name_reason: Accurately describes the function: a BG zoom-in scroll transition for a combat cinematic. Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=animate/bg, descriptor=zoom_transition_in); has a mirror counterpart fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_out. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: BG zoom-in scroll transition for a combat cinematic: camera pushes in toward a combat unit by scrolling a 3-layer parallax background down then up, compositing the unit pose into the work buffer between the two passes.
logic_summary: Phase 1: for frame_iter 9..0, RLE-blit special_attack_bg_layer[frame_iter%3] into workspace, then blit a vertically-offset (frame_iter*0x20) 0x140-row band to mode-13h (0xA0000), giving a downward scroll. Phase 2: clear the 128K workspace and the 64000-byte clear_buf, RLE-blit the terrain backdrop (param caster_figani) into clear_buf, overlay the unit hit-flash (fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite with char_unit_id), blit clear_buf into workspace, then blit the unit pose sheet (param char_sprite_idx, frame 0) into workspace. Phase 3: for frame_iter 9..0, RLE-blit special_attack_bg_layer[(frame_iter+2)%3] into workspace+0x140 (rotated layer cycle), then blit the offset band to mode-13h, giving an upward scroll. The 3 BG-layer pointers are read directly from the real uint32[3] array data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers @ 0x5410B/0F/13.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_in(uint32 char_unit_id, uint32 char_sprite_idx, uint32 clear_buf, uint32 workspace, uint32 caster_figani)

params.name: char_unit_id
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the combat unit being shown; forwarded to fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite to overlay its hit-flash. Callers pass defender_idx / attacker_idx / target_idx_buf[i].
params.reason: Correctly identifies a runtime-char index; no address residue.

params.name: char_sprite_idx
params.semantics: FIGANI/sprite-sheet stream POINTER for the unit pose; passed as fd2_blit_indexed_sprite's sheet_ptr with frame index 0. Callers pass defender_figani / attacker_figani / target_figani[i] (all FIGANI stream pointers).
params.reason: Misnomer: the name says 'index' but the value is a FIGANI/sprite-sheet pointer (it is the sheet_ptr argument of fd2_blit_indexed_sprite, with the literal 0 as the index). Renaming to char_figani matches the caller-supplied *_figani pointers and the existing FIGANI naming convention. Rename deferred to Stage 2.

params.name: clear_buf
params.semantics: 64000-byte (mode-13h sized) scratch buffer; cleared then used to compose terrain backdrop + unit hit-flash before being blitted into workspace. Callers pass framebuffer / pAnimWorkBuf1 (the 64000-byte work area).
params.reason: Correctly describes a cleared 64000-byte scratch buffer; no address residue.

params.name: workspace
params.semantics: 128K (0x1F400) work buffer holding the scrolled background; scroll bands are read from here and committed to mode-13h. Callers pass workspace / pAnimWorkBuf2 (the 0x1F400 work area).
params.reason: Correctly describes the 128K work buffer; no address residue.

params.name: caster_figani
params.semantics: Terrain/BG backdrop RLE sprite-stream pointer, RLE-blitted into clear_buf as the backdrop beneath the unit (passed as fd2_rle_blit_sprite's rle_stream). Callers pass spotlight_bg_buf_ptr / split_bg_b_buf_ptr / pBg_resource (background buffers), NOT a caster FIGANI.
params.reason: Misnomer: the value is the terrain/BG backdrop RLE stream, not a caster FIGANI. The mirror function fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_out names its analogous param terrain_bg. Renaming to terrain_bg makes the two transitions consistent and matches the actual caller arguments. Rename deferred to Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value; output is the scrolled cinematic painted to VGA mode-13h (0xA0000) and the composed unit pose left in workspace.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers (uint32[3] @ 0x5410B/0F/13; the 3-layer parallax BG cache, indexed [frame_iter%3] in Phase 1 and [(frame_iter+2)%3] in Phase 3)
comment_original_issue: The src Params block had two factually wrong descriptions: char_sprite_idx was called an 'atlas/sprite index ... blitted after the silhouette is composed' (it is actually a FIGANI/sprite-sheet pointer passed as sheet_ptr with idx 0), and caster_figani was called 'FIGANI sprite stream for the caster silhouette' (it is actually the terrain/BG backdrop RLE stream, matching the zoom-out counterpart's terrain_bg). The header also said 'approaching attacker'/'attacker silhouette' though the composited unit is the defender in two of the three call sites, and claimed '(2 callers)' while there are 3 call sites.
notes: Logic verified equivalent to decompile (3 phases, all callees and the single global read match get_function_signature callee_names). Param mapping cross-checked against all 3 call sites and the prototypes of fd2_blit_indexed_sprite (first arg sheet_ptr) and fd2_rle_blit_sprite (first arg rle_stream), confirming char_sprite_idx is a sheet pointer and caster_figani is the terrain backdrop. Two renames (char_sprite_idx->char_figani, caster_figani->terrain_bg) recorded only; per rules no symbol/param/declaration was changed in this stage. No logic touched.
